THE REQUEST COMES MORE THAN 6 MONTHS AFTER ENTRY OF DEFAULT. NEW ARGUMENTS 1ST PRESENTED IN THE REPLY MEMO ARE STRICKEN, BUT EVEN IF THEY WERE CONSIDERED THEY WOULD NOT SUPPORT A CONCLUSION THAT ENTRY OF DEFAULT WAS IMPROPER LET ALONE VOID.
